title: Ireland's top scorers since 2000
brief: Name the ten players with the most goals for the Republic of Ireland in full internationals since 1 January 2000, to the end of the 2026 World Cup. Only goals from 2000 on count.
period: Full internationals from 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026

notes.Kevin Kilbane: Kevin Kilbane is joint 11th with 8, just outside.
notes.Damien Duff: Damien Duff is joint 11th with 8, just outside.
notes.Richard Dunne: Richard Dunne is joint 11th with 8, just outside.
notes.Evan Ferguson: Evan Ferguson is joint 11th with 8, just outside.
notes.Adam Idah: Adam Idah had 6 at the end of the 2026 World Cup.
notes.Robbie Keane: Robbie Keane scored 68 for Ireland, 5 of them in 1998 and 1999.
notes.Ian Harte: Ian Harte scored 2 of his 11 before 2000.
notes.Niall Quinn: Niall Quinn scored only 2 of his 21 from 2000.
notes.Roy Keane: Roy Keane scored 4 of his 9 from 2000.
notes.David Connolly: David Connolly scored 2 of his 9 from 2000.
notes.Troy Parrott: Troy Parrott had 11 at the end of the 2026 World Cup; his goals since then don't count here.

sources: https://www.transfermarkt.com/ceapi/performance-game/<player id> (every match a player played, filtered to the national team and the date window)
checks: Counted match by match from Transfermarkt's per-game data, 1 January 2000 to 19 July 2026. Players who began after 2000 checked against RSSSF (to 5 June 2026) and Wikipedia's list of internationals (18 July 2026): all agree (Parrott 11, Morrison 9, Robinson 9, Brady 10). Robbie Keane's 63 from 2000 matches the by-year table in his Wikipedia article. Ian Harte is 11 in all on RSSSF and Transfermarkt, 2 of them in 1996, so 9 from 2000; Wikipedia credits him with 12, which would make 9 or 10 from 2000, so he is in the ten either way.
